correctness.rationale: With u_j=m_j+b_j xi, W=diag(1,1/3) is exactly the physical norm and the Fourier generator is [[z-1,z-1],[3(1-z),-3(1+z)]]. The SSPRK3 polynomial R=I+nu L+nu²L²/2+nu³L³/6 gives D=W-R*WR. The source proves exact rational identities D11=2nu(1-c)Q and det D=-(4/9)nu^4(1-c)^2 F(nu,c), with F affine in c, one edge factor containing p(nu)=18nu^4-9nu^3+3nu²+5nu-1 and the other negative up to 1/5. All 18 tensor Bernstein coefficients of Q on [0,1/5]x[0,2] are strictly positive; verified rational certificate source VERIFY.py establishes identities by 13x13 degree-bounded interpolation, and independent recalculation matched determinant at several rational values. p strictly increases and has unique positive zero 0.18645728037; constant Fourier mode is nonexpansive below threshold. Above it, near-zero nonzero Fourier angles have det D<0, and dense roots of unity give some real finite-grid input with strict one-step energy growth. No assertion of instability on each fixed grid nor nonlinear entropy.
